item.title: Dashboard
item.description:
A graphical dashboard for the engine — containers, images, volumes and a wctr terminal — built with go-widgets, running in the browser on the same engine and API as wctr. Every action shows the wctr command it stands for. This is dashboard v0.3.0, which runs on engine v0.8.0.

What it does

  • The Start, Stop and Restart buttons use the engine’s /start, /stop and /restart, and show the matching wctr start|stop|restart NAME line in the footer and in the terminal. Stop returns once the container has exited.
  • The status bar shows the storage, from GET /system/df (for example IndexedDB 2MB of 1GB (persistent)).
  • It follows GET /events instead of polling. When the stream drops, it refreshes and reconnects from the last event.
  • The Volumes view shows each volume’s size and use count, and can create, inspect, remove (with force) and prune; each action shows its wctr volume … line.
  • A container’s detail shows its mounts and a Stats tab: a memory gauge against the limit, a sparkline of recent readings, bytes written, log size and pids. CPU is shown as -- because it is not measured.
  • The run dialog accepts -v NAME:/path[:ro].
  • It was tested live in Chromium and Firefox.

Live demo: https://go-wasmcontainers.github.io/dashboard/. Source: go-wasmcontainers/dashboard.

The terminal widget

The terminal in the dashboard is the Terminal widget that go-widgets/toolkit v0.342.0 adds: a subset of xterm, safe for untrusted output. It has no reply channel (nothing the output prints is ever sent back), and OSC, DCS and APC sequences are dropped.

Limitations

  • The standalone demo keeps its state in memory: nothing persists across a reload. In the playground the dashboard runs on the persistent engine worker instead.
  • Browsers keep Ctrl-W, Ctrl-T and Ctrl-N, so the terminal cannot use them.
  • dashboard.wasm is 20.45 MB raw and 5.32 MB gzipped; a size reduction of go-widgets is in progress (planned).

In the playground

The dashboard is now the playground’s default UI on the live site (Containers, Images, Volumes, Terminal). The terminal-only page stays at ?ui=terminal. This is deployed on the playground’s main branch and is not in a playground tag yet: the latest tag is v0.2.0.
